source_title: Entering an invalid console command with a disallowed chat character in it crashes the server
raw_log:
Description: Exception in server tick loop
java.lang.RuntimeException: Failed to encode Minecraft Component: empty[style={color=gray,clickEvent=SuggestCommand[command=/hsay test]}, siblings=[literal{hsay test}[style={color=red,underlined}], translation{key='command.context.here', args=[]}[style={color=red,italic}]]]; Disallowed chat character: ''
